title: CDAO OpenAI Prototype Agreement and Initial Obligation
summary: The daily contract notice records a $200 million fixed-amount prototype other transaction agreement with OpenAI Public Sector and $1,999,998 in fiscal 2025 funds obligated at award.
key_findings: The performer, agreement identifier, ceiling value, initial obligation, work domain, and estimated completion are named.
The stated value and amount obligated at award are materially different.
No delivered prototype, evaluation, acceptance, fielding, or production outcome is identified.
why_it_matters: The record is a concrete federal AI acquisition action and a test of whether FTFN can keep agreement value separate from delivery and operational use.
ftfn_relevance: Creates an agreement-level trail for later obligations and outputs.
Pairs with GAO's system-level warning about prototype-to-production evidence.
evidence_limits: The notice does not identify tasking, delivered systems, model performance, infrastructure, users, evaluation, acceptance, or production.
The agreement ceiling is not equivalent to obligated or spent funds.
